description: Better Stack (Logtail) source tokens committed to source the way the vendor quickstarts get pasted: positional in new Logtail("<token>") for Node/winston, as source_token= in Python's LogtailHandler, and as a LOGTAIL_SOURCE_TOKEN constant for a fetch-based edge logger. Each lets anyone write to (and flood) the log source — VC181 must fire on all three.
